text: Which word goes in front of 'flake', 'ball' and 'man' to make three new words?
why: Snowflake, snowball, snowman.

text: How many sides do three triangles and two squares have altogether?
I double a number and add 6, and get 20. What was the number?
why: 20 − 6 = 14, and half of 14 is 7.

text: A train leaves at 10:50 and the journey takes 1 hour 25 minutes. What time does it arrive?
why: 10:50 plus an hour is 11:50; 25 minutes more is 12:15.

text: How many times does the letter E appear in the word SEVENTEEN?
why: sEvEntEEn: four Es.

text: Ann is taller than Ben, Ben is taller than Cal, and Cal is taller than Dee. Who is the second shortest?
why: Shortest first: Dee, Cal, Ben, Ann.

text: What do all six faces of an ordinary dice add up to?
What number is missing: 3, 6, 12, 24, ___, 96?
why: Each number doubles: 24 × 2 = 48, and 48 × 2 = 96.

text: How many minutes are there in a quarter of a day?
why: A quarter of 24 hours is 6 hours, and 6 × 60 = 360.

text: Written as a word, which whole number from 1 to 20 has the most letters?
why: SEVENTEEN has nine letters; thirteen, fourteen, eighteen and nineteen have eight.

text: Which capital city is hidden in this sentence: 'The parish rose to the challenge'?
why: PARISh hides PARIS.

text: Which country is hidden in this sentence: 'Each in a box goes to the post office'?
why: eaCH IN A hides CHINA.

text: Which colour is hidden in this sentence: 'The cab lacked a spare tyre'?
why: caB LACKed hides BLACK.

text: Which farm animal is hidden in this sentence: 'Eric owed his friend a fiver'?
why: eriC OWed hides COW.

text: What day comes three days after the day before Friday?
why: The day before Friday is Thursday, and three days after Thursday is Sunday.

text: Which planet is hidden in this sentence: 'They paid their gym arsenal of fees'?
why: gyM ARSenal hides MARS.

text: Counting both days, how many days are there from 1 July to 31 December?
What is the smallest four-digit number you can make using each of 3, 0, 7 and 1 once?
why: It can't start with 0, so put 1 first, then 0, 3 and 7.

text: What is the next number: 1, 8, 27, 64, ___?
why: They are cubes: 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³, so next is 5³ = 125.

text: How many letters of the alphabet come after the letter that comes after Q?
why: The letter after Q is R, and S to Z is eight letters.

text: A week from yesterday will be Tuesday. What day is it today?
why: A week from yesterday is the same weekday as yesterday, so yesterday was Tuesday and today is Wednesday.

text: A six-pointed star is drawn as two overlapping triangles. How many triangles can you count in it altogether?
why: The two big triangles, plus the six small points: 8.

text: A brick weighs 1 kilogram plus half a brick. How much does a whole brick weigh?
why: If 1 kg is the other half of the brick, the whole brick is 2 kg.

text: Write the numbers one to ten as words. How many of them contain the letter E?
why: One, three, five, seven, eight, nine and ten: two, four and six don't.

text: A digital clock shows 12:51. How many minutes until the four digits next read the same backwards?
why: The next time that reads the same both ways is 13:31, 40 minutes later.

text: Which five-letter word, written in capital letters, still reads the same when you turn the page upside down?
why: Turn SWIMS through 180 degrees and the S, W, I, M and S land back as SWIMS.

text: Rearrange the letters of NEW DOOR to make just one word.
why: NEW DOOR is an anagram of ONE WORD, which is exactly what you were asked for.
